run_metadata.coverage_summary: All source tiers were attempted exactly as on prior runs (Tier 1 Commonwealth + all 8 state/territory portals; Tier 2 councils/VendorPanel/GBEs/water corps/universities/health; Tier 3 private-sector e-sourcing hubs and major-buyer portals), plus a dedicated source-discovery sweep. Connectivity was re-tested fresh at the start of this run: WebFetch to the Tier 1 control host www.tenders.gov.au returned EGRESS_BLOCKED; direct curl to www.tenders.gov.au returned 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'; WebFetch to www.vendorpanel.com.au and to data.gov.au also returned EGRESS_BLOCKED. The agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true, selective=false, bundleCoversEveryHost=true, recentRelayFailures empty, yet every external CONNECT is rejected (only noProxy infrastructure hosts - Anthropic API, npm/PyPI/crates/go registries - are reachable). The proxy README states a 403/407 from the proxy is an organisation egress-policy denial that must be reported and must NOT be retried or routed around. This is the SAME session-wide deny-by-default egress block seen on the 2026-09-30 through 2026-10-08 runs - now the TENTH consecutive day (2026-09-30 to 2026-10-09). WebSearch still works (it routes through the Anthropic API, not the egress proxy) and was used for a Tier 1-3 source-discovery sweep. Because the spec's fidelity rule requires every tender detail to be taken from the actual notice or its documents, and no notice or tender-detail page could be opened or verified, NO opportunity could be confirmed - so this run records ZERO tenders rather than repeating unverified aggregator/search snippets. The source-discovery sweep surfaced nine buyer-originated procurement sources not present in any prior run (Austal Australia; Luerssen Australia SEA 1180 supplier portal; Civmec supplier portal; St John of God Health Care; Shire of East Pilbara WA; Shire of Ashburton WA; Quilpie Shire Council QLD; Adelaide Plains Council SA; Hobart International Airport); all are recorded in discovered_sources with a clear note that they were surfaced via WebSearch and could NOT be fetch-verified this run due to the egress block. No tenders, deliverables, dates, contacts, or corporate opportunities were invented.
gaps: Session-wide organisation egress block (10th consecutive day, 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-09): WebFetch returns EGRESS_BLOCKED and direct curl returns 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' for every external host tested (www.tenders.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, data.gov.au). Only noProxy infrastructure hosts (Anthropic API, npm/PyPI/crates/go registries) are reachable.
Tier 1 (AusTender + all 8 state/territory portals): could NOT be fetched or verified - every detail page and feed/API is behind the egress block. No opportunities confirmed.
Tier 2 (councils/VendorPanel, GBEs, water corps, universities, health): could NOT be fetched or verified. Candidate sources were only surfaced via WebSearch snippets.

Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, Coupa, major-buyer portals BHP/Rio/Woodside/Woolworths/Coles/Qantas/banks/telcos/defence primes): could NOT be fetched or verified. Ariba Discovery and all corporate portals are unreachable; no publicly-advertised corporate RFx could be confirmed, so none recorded as tenders (per spec, gated/invitation-only corporate RFx are not invented).
WebSearch returns titles/snippets only and cannot substitute for opening the buyer's own notice; per the fidelity rule, snippet-only data is not treated as a confirmed opportunity.
New sources below were discovered via WebSearch only and are NOT fetch-verified this run; confidence is set accordingly and they should be re-verified once egress is restored.
Invitation-only corporate RFx (e.g. management-consultancy RFPs to Accenture/KPMG/Deloitte) remain out of scope and are not discoverable; noted here rather than fabricated.

discovered_sources.source_name: Austal Australia - Supplier Registration (Gateway by ICN)

Not fetch-verified this run due to egress block.

Exact landing URL inferred from search context and NOT verified; confirm once egress is restored.

Not fetch-verified this run due to egress block.
